evidence: decorative_mascot: Across seg2:start/mid/end (t=20.0-28.3s) Data just stands on the 2022 pill and drifts a few pixels; he never runs a setup->action->payoff bit tied to 25.8M boxes, and does the same perch on the bars at seg0:mid and the bubble at seg3:end.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start/mid/end are the same frame: two rounded pills labelled 2022 and 1990 already at full height with a static 'VS' between them, unchanged for the whole ~12s beat; the mascot merely stands inside the purple pill.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison bars finish their grow-in before the beat's first sampled frame, so the scene has no animation budget left and the 1.2M -> 25.8M boxes claim is never demonstrated - the pills carry no unit, no count, nothing that accumulates.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Re-time seg2 so the 1990 and 2022 quantities build across the beat (fill/stack in counted units of boxes rather than snapping to final height), and give Data one act tied to the 21x growth - e.g. loading the small 1990 pill, then being buried as the 2022 pill overtakes him - so the scene has setup, action and payoff instead of a 12s hold.
